| Disoriented / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / A Disoriented creature suffers the effects of their equilibrium and sense of balance being impeded. / A Disoriented creature suffers a -1 penalty to attack rolls for each rank they have. / A creature with 3 or more ranks of Disoriented must spend its Bonus Action at the beginning of its turn to target one creature it can see. The target creature is the only creature they can target with attacks, jutsu or effects that requires them to select a creature to harm. / A creature with 5 or more ranks of Disoriented cannot make attacks as they cannot reliably target creatures. / Creatures that are immune to psychic damage or the Dazzled condition is immune to this condition. / A Disoriented creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Kashu clan's mastery of sound extends beyond the battlefield. By performing on your Shinobi Instrument for at least 10 minutes, creatures that can hear you, you weave a subtle emotional undercurrent into your music. For the next 24 hours, the first time you or an allied creature socially interacts with a creature that heard your song, the initiating creature gains a +4 bonus to any Charisma based check made. If you or an allied creature attempts a Charisma Skill based action during this time against a creature that heard your song, they make any contested check or saving throw to resist or otherwise at disadvantage. Once a creature is affected by your song in this way, they become immune to its effects until they complete a Full-Rest.

Additionally, as part of this performance, if you are inside a building, you saturate the area with lingering frequencies. You learn the exact structural layout of the building you occupy within a 120-foot radius, penetrating through walls, and barriers that aren’t chakra enhanced. This does not reveal creatures, only the structural layout, possibly revealing hidden rooms or trap doors.
